findings.title: Frozen edition does not yet provide the requested integrated historical relationship map
findings.description: Existing explorer has case/chronology/comparison layers and local incident-edge cards; global diagram is expressly an analytical guide. There is no integrated evidence-bearing historical relationship overview across eras/regions. 138 weak components, maximum seven nodes, three multi-case components, zero multi-case edges and zero cross-contribution edges describe the evidence represented, not a demand to force connectivity.
findings.acceptance: Provide a navigable relationship overview preserving documented/inferred transmission or development, scoped engineering dependence, chronology/context and analogy as distinct layers. Link relations to exact claims/locators and uncertainty. Retain disconnected or unresolved histories; do not merge similar labels, infer transmission from dates, or force a unified tree. Do not claim acceptance for the forthcoming layer until separately inspected.

findings.title: Case coverage is complete but significant later subepisodes remain hidden from era entry routes
findings.description: NET-C02 spans 868–c1850 and NET-C03 1377–early nineteenth century, yet both appear only in the broadly pre1500 route. Early-modern publishing lists NET-C04/C05/C06 without them. NET-X01 provides an indirect bridge, so cases are not lost; the date-route entry is incomplete for comparative reading.
findings.acceptance: When developing the historical layer, add explicit later-episode route memberships or episode links for these histories. Keep operating episodes distinct from modern research/reconstruction dates.

findings.title: Markdown edge inventory advertises links it does not provide
findings.description: GLOBAL_MAP says the edge inventory links each relationship to cases, claims and sources. GRAPH_GUIDE emits plain case/claim/edge identifiers and no source column; COMPARISONS also emits plain case IDs. The explorer resolves these references correctly, so this is limited to the Markdown reading path.
findings.acceptance: Make the Markdown IDs links to explorer record views or case/evidence sections, and include source references or accurately describe the inventory as an unlinked index.
